english.title: Attach pipe or apparatus to resource or water main or service pipe without consent
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without the consent of the water undertaker, attached

(A)_[a pipe]_
(B)_[apparatus, namely **(..SPECIFY APPARATUS..),]_

to a

(C)_[resource main vested in a water undertaker, namely **(..SPECIFY WATER UNDERTAKER..)]_
(D)_[water main vested in a water undertaker, namely **(..SPECIFY WATER UNDERTAKER..)]_
(E)_[pipe vested in a water undertaker, namely **(..SPECIFY WATER UNDERTAKER..)]_
(F)_[service pipe which did not belong to a water undertaker but was a pipe by means of which water was supplied by such an undertaker to premises at **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 174(3)(a) of the Water Industry Act 1991.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
without the consent of the water undertaker,
attached a pipe or apparatus
to a resource main, water main or other pipe vested in a water undertaker
or to a service pipe which did not belong to such an undertaker
but was a pipe by means of which water was supplied by such an undertaker to premises
